resources.string: Link this headunit to the KlikBeam account on your phone. See where this car is parked and its trip history in the KlikBeam app. Optional: everything else in KlikDash works without an account.

Only while linked: the route, distance, time and speed of each trip, and where the car was last parked. It is sent when the headunit is online (for example through your phone\'s hotspot) and only your account can see it. Free accounts keep 7 days of history.
On your phone, open KlikBeam › ACCOUNT › ADD CAR and scan this QR code. The code is valid until %1$s.
Can\'t reach the KlikBeam server. Make sure the headunit is online, for example through your phone\'s hotspot, then try again.
The code has expired. Create a new one.
This car is saved as %1$s in your KlikBeam account. Rename or remove it in the KlikBeam app.
This car and its trip history are removed from your KlikBeam account, and trips not sent yet are discarded. Link again any time with a new QR code.
Records the route, distance and speed while the car moves, and sends it when the headunit is online.
Off: trips are not recorded and the parking spot is not updated.
